PACKAGING ENGINEERING · RFQ START POINT

Designed to sell.
Engineered to travel.

The selected C route combines high-impact colour and oversized type with an angular visible-food window. Window size, film structure, light exposure, barrier loss, seal performance and transit safety must be validated with the real product before artwork lock.

DISTRIBUTOR FAQ

Facts before
the first order.

Direct answers for pet food importers, distributors and retail partners evaluating TALVUMI.

Who can become a TALVUMI distribution partner?

We welcome applications from qualified importers, national and regional pet food distributors, retail chains, specialist pet retailers and ecommerce operators.

Which pet food products are planned for launch?

The initial commercial candidates include adult cat ocean fish recipe, adult dog beef recipe and kitten ocean fish recipe. Final formulas, pack sizes, claims and availability depend on manufacturer documentation and market registration.

Does TALVUMI offer private label pet food?

TALVUMI is the export-facing brand. Separate OEM or private-label opportunities are assessed case by case and are not implied by a distributor appointment.

Are exclusive territories available?

Territory rights are never automatic. Any exclusivity, targets, registration responsibilities and commercial terms require a written agreement after capability review.

What information should a distributor application include?

Tell us your country, import status, active retail accounts, sales channels, priority cities and intended launch window. This lets both sides judge commercial fit before discussing samples or terms.
